executiveSummary: Over the past 7 days, live API tracking across YouTube, Steam, and Google News indicates an overall sentiment of 25% positive for FC 26 out of 95 verified human feedback items. While promotional updates such as the final week of the Futties promo alongside Season 10 pre-season rewards and the implementation of the new Community API update garnered favorable attention, community feedback highlights critical friction points. Steam and YouTube users frequently cite aggressive discounting ($14-$18 price points and 80% off sales), lack of PC/keyboard optimization, difficult man-marking mechanics, and overly rapid gameplay that lacks realism.

keyAnomalies.anomalyTitle: PC Optimization and Keyboard Usability Failures
keyAnomalies.rootCause: Players report that the game forces the use of a controller, lacking proper optimization for PC and keyboard users.

keyAnomalies.anomalyTitle: Gameplay Pace and Defensive Mechanics Friction
keyAnomalies.rootCause: Users criticize the game for being too smooth and fast to the point of unreality, alongside difficult man-marking and rigid tactical meta constraints.

immediateMitigations.actionTitle: PC Usability and Control Patch Evaluation
immediateMitigations.payloadSnippet: Investigate native keyboard mapping and PC optimization hotfixes to address Steam player grievances regarding controller dependency.

sampleFeed.author: Steam Verified Player
sampleFeed.title: Steam Review: Not Recommended
sampleFeed.content: Seriously EA, please fix FC 26 before you start working on another game. I’m so tired of this ♥♥♥♥. We are paying full price for a game that still has so many bugs. Every year you release a new FC, add some new features, change a few things and expect us to pay again while the previous game is still broken. The ICON bug in Career Mode is especially annoying. I edited my squad and added some ICONs to my team, started a new Career using Current Squads and everything was fine. I played a few games, saved my Career and closed the game. Then I came back later and my ICONs were ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ gone. They were replaced by random normal players that I never even put in my squad. What is the point of letting us edit squads if the game just deletes the changes when we load the Career? And the worst part is that I actually spent time building this team and playing the Career, and now I basically have to start over because the game can't even keep the players I added. And this isn't even the only problem, there are still black loading screens, audio bugs, Player Career bugs, Create a Club problems and a bunch of other random ♥♥♥♥ happening all the time. How is this acceptable? Please stop trying to sell us another FC game and actually fix the one we already paid for. I don't want another game with a new menu and a few new animations, I just want the basic stuff to ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ work. Fix FC 26 first, then worry about FC 27.
